text:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 7 action owners + short timelines for the streaming/chat remediation work (timeouts / partial responses / reconnect logic). Adding a compact checklist for ops + infra.

elaine: Summary: recurring partial responses linked to client retry patterns and occasional proxy-induced mid-stream resets. We need concrete ownership and short experiments to validate mitigations.

matt: taking SDK retry policy + trace header. Plan: implement per-client sliding retry budget, jittered exponential backoff, propagate `x-rdinference-trace` and `x-rdinference-retry-id`. Target PR in 48h.

sri: server-side: implement optional tail-hold (200ms default) and final-ack frame. Will bench memory impact; prototype in 3d.

julia: telemetry: add `stream.partial_rate`, `stream.tail_hold_count`, `stream.retry_budget_trips`; create dashboard + alerts. ETA next week.

henry: infra: verify proxy/LB keepalive behavior, ensure `x-` headers preserved on canary, run keepalive alignment test during canary window.

zack: docs/playbook: update incident runbook with triage checklist and rotation. also add steps to collect last-100 chunk timestamps and retry-ids. ETA end of week.

elaine: ops-bot: please create INF tickets and schedule biweekly follow-ups for 6 weeks.

ops-bot: Tickets: INF-3450 (SDK retry + headers) -> matt, due 2d. INF-3451 (server tail-hold + final-ack) -> sri, due 4d. INF-3452 (stream telemetry & alerts) -> julia, due 7d. INF-3453 (LB/proxy keepalive tests) -> henry, due 5d. INF-3454 (incident runbook update) -> zack, due 3d. Biweekly reminders scheduled.

matt: pseudocode for retry budget:
```
window = 60s
max_attempts = 5
if attempts_in(window) > max_attempts: open_circuit(30s)
backoff = min(8000, base * 2**attempt) * jitter
```
will log `x-rdinference-retry-id` for correlation.

sri: server approach: buffer last-chunk candidates for `stream.tail_hold_ms` and wait for trailing frames; emit `stream.tail_held_count` when buffer used. config will default to disabled until canary.

julia: proposed alerting: page on `stream.partial_rate > 0.75% for 5m`, slack-only at lower thresholds. Also add anomaly detection on `reconnects/min`.

henry: scheduling canary window Thu 10:00-12:00 PT. will run synthetic reconnect flood test and toggles.

zack: adding quick checklist to INF-3454: collect trace headers, SDK version, last-100 chunks, check for 499/ECONNRESETs, escalate to infra if proxy seen.

elaine: blockers: mobile SDK rollout (matt), proxy header preservation (henry), server memory (sri). note any others.

matt: mobile could be delayed, will add feature flag and gradual rollout plan.

sri: memory impact expected < 3% if enabled; will validate.

julia: please ensure retry-id is added to every reconnect attempt, that helps stitching.

henry: will ensure header forwarding on canary; global change needs coordination.

zack: scheduling 30m sync Tue 10:30 next week. add short updates to INF tickets.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up on 1756200000 (two weeks).

matt: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/512 (retry budget + headers). tagging reviewers.

sri: prototype underway; posting bench numbers to INF-3451 when ready.

julia: dashboard skeleton created; wiring alerts this week.

elaine: great. aim: reduce customer partials by 50% in 2 weeks and eliminate reconnect storm escalations. please update ticket comments with progress. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
